title: Five ways small businesses are using AI right now, and where to be careful
dek: You don’t need a data science team. Here’s where AI is saving owners real hours, and the mistakes to avoid.
body:
The biggest AI story for most people isn't a new model. It's the owner of a bakery, a dental office or a real estate team who got ten hours of their week back. Here's where small businesses are getting value today.

## 1. Writing the first draft

Emails, listing descriptions, social captions, job posts and proposals. AI is very good at a solid first draft that you then make your own.

**Be careful:** always read before you send. AI can state things confidently that aren't true, like a feature a product doesn't have or a detail about a property.

## 2. Answering common customer questions

Chat assistants on a website or messaging app can handle hours, pricing, booking and FAQs around the clock, and hand off to a person when they get stuck.

**Be careful:** make the handoff to a human easy, and don't let a bot make promises about refunds or contracts.

## 3. Summarizing the paperwork

Contracts, inspection reports, meeting notes, long email threads. Ask for a summary and a list of action items.

**Be careful:** check your industry's rules before uploading client data, and use business accounts that don't train on your data.

## 4. Marketing on a budget

Content calendars, ad variations, image ideas, and turning one blog post into a week of social posts. This is where many owners see results first.

**Be careful:** keep your own voice. Readers can tell when every post sounds the same.

## 5. Bookkeeping and admin

Categorizing expenses, chasing invoices and forecasting cash flow are now built into many accounting tools.

**Be careful:** AI helps with the busywork; your accountant still signs off on the numbers.

## Getting started

Pick one task that eats your time every week. Try an AI tool on it for two weeks, and measure the hours saved. That's the whole playbook. Want to see what other owners are doing? Follow our [Main Street AI desk](/section/mainstreet).
